item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Sleep. Last night you got roughly seven and a half hours, down before midnight, up a bit after seven — solid, but bedtime tonight is set even earlier. You started the day with meds handled and a real breakfast, which sets a good tone. The pattern that matters isn't one good night, it's stacking them. Tonight, stick to the wind-down routine already on your schedule and get lights out on time.
